# P0 — Runtime proof & delivery infrastructure

- [x] **P0.1 — M0 live task acceptance** — Prove one real task can travel from authenticated ChatGPT response through contract parsing, patch application, canonical validation, and a clean committed worktree, producing the required evidence artifact.

- [x] **P0.3 — M2 kill/restart recovery** — Exercise exact-operation recovery across browser reload, bridge restart, and runner restart; prove the original operation is reclaimed exactly once without prompt resubmission.
- [ ] **P0.4 — 168-hour long-run acceptance** — Run the real seven-day supervisor after M0/M1/M2 and capture throughput, recovery, failure-signature, branch, PR, and resource evidence.

- **Start:** 2026-09-22
- **Target completion:** 2026-10-04
